title: Settings
subtitle: Workspace and notifications.
placeholder: More settings will appear as modules ship.
telegramSubtitle: Task/order alerts plus /tasks, /report. The link code has 10 characters (digits 0–9 and a–f).
telegramCodeReady: Code is ready — use it in Telegram.
telegramUpstream: API is unreachable or still starting (proxy 503).
telegramError: Could not get a code. Refresh or check your permissions.
telegramStepBot: Open a private chat with your BotFather bot.
telegramStepSend: Send ONE message: /start, a space, then the ten characters below (not the English word CODE). Valid about 15 minutes.
telegramHintBot: Locally: TOKEN + NODE_ENV=development is enough (polling starts automatically unless a full webhook URL + secret are set). Production requires TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL + secret; old webhooks are cleared when polling boots.
